Octave, a leader in lifecycle intelligence software, helps organizations connect data across design, build, operate and protect phases to transform how they manage complex assets and operations. 
 
Within this platform, Octave Reliance delivers a connected quality management solution with AI embedded directly into the platform, enabling organizations to automate workflows, connect data across systems and reduce cost, risk and time to market. 
 
Quality leaders across industries rely on Reliance to strengthen supplier performance, scale compliance and turn quality into a strategic driver of business performance.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription:
Octave Reliance (formerly ETQ Reliance) is a flexible and configurable enterprise Quality Management System (QMS) platform designed for government organizations and suppliers to design, implement and evolve quality processes to meet their unique and changing needs. With over 40 ready-to-use applications providing building blocks for robust, interconnected business processes, Octave Reliance serves as the backbone of a closed-loop quality ecosystem.


Measurable Value Across Critical Operations
The platform enables government agencies and their supply chains to deliver measurable value across critical operational areas:
Cost of Poor Quality – Reduce waste and rework through systematic quality controls (up to 32% or more reduction in scrap and rework achieved by global manufacturers)
Time to Market – Accelerate product delivery with automated workflows and streamlined processes (up to 80% improvement in new product introduction cycle times)
Supplier Quality – Strengthen supply chain resilience and compliance with complete visibility and control
Decision Velocity – Make faster, data-driven decisions with integrated analytics and predictive AI dashboards (customers have seen a 50% reduction in CAPA and SCAR resolution time)
Compliance at Scale – Maintain regulatory adherence across complex organizations with audit-ready workflows and automated recordkeeping
Proven Government & Defense Expertise
Trusted by hundreds of customers in manufacturing and service organizations and actively deployed across aerospace, defense and advanced manufacturing. With decades of service in regulated government and defense environments, Reliance is purpose-built for mission-critical quality operations. The platform supports complex supplier networks, stringent compliance requirements and the scalability needed for federal programs and global supply chains. Codeless configuration allows government teams to adapt processes without IT dependency.

 
Comprehensive Quality Capabilities
Octave Reliance provides integrated applications across the entire quality lifecycle:
Foundation & Governance – Document Control, Training Management, Audit Management, Quality Events
Problem Resolution & Prevention – Nonconformance Management, CAPA (Corrective Actions), Risk Assessment, Change Management
Supply Chain & Operations – Supplier Quality, Health & Safety, Environmental Management
Insights & Intelligence – Advanced Analytics, Predictive Dashboards, Real-time KPIs

All capabilities are integrated into a closed-loop ecosystem that reduces the cost of poor quality, accelerates time to market, strengthens supplier quality and ensures compliance at scale.


Enterprise-Grade Cloud Architecture
Built on AWS cloud infrastructure designed to support government and regulated industry requirements. ISO 27001 certified and compliant with 21 CFR Part 11, the platform provides role and location-based access control, comprehensive audit trails and encryption capabilities to protect sensitive quality and supplier data.

Government agencies trust Octave Reliance to modernize quality infrastructure while maintaining the operational resilience and governance required in defense and government operations.
